map.持有成本模型：理论价 F = S×(1 + (r + u − q)×T)（单利）: Cost of carry model: theoretical price F = S x (1 + (r + u - q) x T) (simple interest) or S*e^((r+u-q)T) (continuous), where S is the spot price, r the interest rate, u the storage rate, q the dividend yield and T the time to expiry...

map.基差负说明什么？: What does a negative basis mean?
map.正向市场中期货高于现货、基差为负属正常；基差走阔/收窄反映持有成本与预期变化，用: In contango the futures price is above spot and a negative basis is normal; the widening or narrowing of the basis reflects carrying costs and changing expectations, used in arbitrage and hedging decisions.
